$comment: N-98: the one source of the product positioning. npm run docs:sync renders it into README.md, docs/index.html, docs/llms.txt and the manifest descriptions; {tools}, {packages} and {defaultTools} are filled from the registry. The GitHub About text is set from `about` by the owner.
headline: Safe AI writes
for ServiceNow.
what: An MCP server that connects any MCP client — Claude Desktop, Claude Code, VS Code Copilot Chat, Cursor — to a ServiceNow instance over its REST APIs.
value: Every write is previewed first, a destructive one needs a single-use plan token, and record writes are journaled and can be reverted. Alongside that comes IDE-grade code intelligence: find usages, what runs on save, and drift between instances. Free and local, and it works on your PDI.
counts: {tools} tools in {packages} packages: {defaultTools} load by default and SN_TOOL_PACKAGES adds the rest, so the tool list stays small in tokens.
disclaimer: It is an independent community project and is not affiliated with ServiceNow, Inc.
